gloss_en: (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain; it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons; it is considered a unit of heredity
gloss_source: UKC, concept 29340 (ukc.datascientia.eu)
notes: The UKC gloss describes protein-coding genes; our Gene (from HGNC) also includes non-coding genes (e.g. lncRNA) and pseudogenes.

gloss_en: A set or series of interactions, often forming a network, which biologists have found useful to group together for organizational, historic, biophysical, or other reasons.
gloss_source: NCI Thesaurus 26.02d (release 2026-03-19), NCIT:C54214, read through EBI OLS
notes: Not in the UKC: the UKC 'pathway' concepts are a trodden path (UKC-21030) and a nerve pathway (UKC-29542). Chosen over PW:0000001 and NCIT:C20633 because a Hallmark gene set is a grouping of genes for a biological state or process, not necessarily a sequence of reactions.

gloss_en: A cell type is a distinct morphological or functional form of cell. Examples are epithelial, glial etc.
gloss_source: Experimental Factor Ontology v3.96.0, EFO:0000324, read through EBI OLS
notes: Not in the UKC (only 'cell', UKC-34). EFO is reached through NCBO BioPortal / OLS. Our CellType is qualified by context: cell name + tissue class + disease category (Phase 1, D5).

gloss_en: an impairment of health or a condition of abnormal functioning
gloss_source: UKC, concept 67092 (ukc.datascientia.eu)
notes: The instances are MONDO terms (Phase 1, D15); aligning the class to the MONDO root MONDO:0000001 is left to Phase 3 (O5).

gloss_en: a relation between a continuant and a process, in which the continuant is somehow involved in the process
gloss_source: Relation Ontology (release 2026-09-04), RO:0000056, read through EBI OLS
notes: Exception to L1: the UKC has the verb 'participate' (UKC-104720, 'share in something', child of 'act'), but its sense is too generic for a gene-process relation. RO:0002350 'member of' describes the data (a gene in a gene set) but does not match the term name.

gloss_en: c is marker for d iff the presence or occurrence of d is correlated with the presence of occurrence of c, and the observation of c is used to infer the presence or occurrence of d. Note that this does not imply that c and d are in a direct causal relationship, as it may be the case that there is a third entity e that stands in a direct causal relationship with c and d.
gloss_source: Relation Ontology (release 2026-09-04), RO:0002607, read through EBI OLS
notes: Not in the UKC as a relation: the UKC only has the noun 'genetic marker' (UKC-29345, a kind of gene). The inverse in RO is RO:0017011 'has marker'.

gloss_en: A gene is a reported marker for a cell type when CellMarker has at least one record of it collected from a study, a review, or a company, rather than predicted by a computational tool.
gloss_source: written by the project (from Phase 1, D17)
notes: rdfs:subPropertyOf tpkg:isMarkerFor (Phase 1, D17). Not in the UKC or RO; closest UKC words: 'reported' (UKC-76629).

gloss_en: A gene is a predicted marker for a cell type when all the CellMarker records of it come from computational marker-detection tools.
gloss_source: written by the project (from Phase 1, D17)
notes: rdfs:subPropertyOf tpkg:isMarkerFor (Phase 1, D17). Not in the UKC or RO; closest UKC word: 'predict' (UKC-97016).

gloss_en: A cell type is observed in a disease when CellMarker has at least one record of the cell type in that disease; it does not say which of its markers were found there.
parent_concept: UKC-105475 (occur: to be found to exist)
gloss_source: written by the project (from Phase 1, D7)
notes: The UKC verbs 'observe' (UKC-96181, UKC-103363) have the active sense of someone observing. The only ontology term with this name, TXPO:0003500 'observed in', has no definition and is outside the proposal.

gloss_en: Identifier for a gene approved by the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_2298
notes: identifying attribute UKC has only the generic concept 'identifier' (UKC-38423).

gloss_en: A unique gene name approved by an organism specific nomenclature committee.
gloss_source: NCI Thesaurus 26.02d (release 2026-03-19), read through EBI OLS, NCIT:C43568
notes: UKC has only the generic concept 'symbol' (UKC-35830). Chosen over EDAM:data_1026 because its gloss says 'approved'.

gloss_en: The name of a gene, (typically) assigned by a person and/or according to a naming scheme. It may contain white space characters and is typically more intuitive and readable than a gene symbol. It (typically) may be used to identify similar genes in different species and to derive a gene symbol.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_2299
notes: UKC has only the generic concept 'name' (UKC-2).

gloss_en: The short name of a gene; a single word that does not contain white space characters. It is typically derived from the gene name.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_1026
notes: multi-valued; renamed to singular (RDF convention) UKC has only the generic concept 'symbol' (UKC-35830). A source symbol is not necessarily approved (it can be a previous or alias symbol), so the generic EDAM concept fits better than NCIT:C43568.

gloss_en: The way a gene symbol of a source dataset was matched to its HGNC entry: on the approved symbol, or on a unique previous or alias symbol.
gloss_source: written by the project (HGNC resolution statuses defined for the data layer of this phase)
notes: renamed: says which resolution it refers to UKC 'status' (UKC-66447) only has the sense of social standing. Renamed from hgncResolutionStatus on 2026-11-18 (decision D21): only resolved genes enter the KG, so the values are only approved_symbol or prev_or_alias.

gloss_en: Identifier of an entry from a database of biological pathways or networks.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_1082
notes: identifying attribute UKC has only the generic 'identifier' (UKC-38423). EDAM has database-specific pathway IDs (KEGG, BioCyc, Panther, WikiPathways) but none for MSigDB; NCIT:C164894 'Pathway Identifier' has only an alternative definition.

gloss_en: A human-readable name for the subject.
gloss_source: W3C RDF Schema (http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#), rdfs:comment of rdfs:label
notes: merged with the Disease label into the standard rdfs:label Standard RDF property, reused as it is (no tpkg: term).

gloss_en: A Uniform Resource Locator (URL).
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_1052
notes: Not in the UKC ('URL', 'web address' not found).

gloss_en: The name of a type or group of cells.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_2892
notes: part of the CellType identity key (D5) Not in the UKC ('cell type' not found).

gloss_en: The broad tissue or organ category under which CellMarker groups a record (138 values, e.g. Lung, Bone); a tissue class contains one or more tissue types.
gloss_source: written by the project (from the Phase 1 inspection of CellMarker)
notes: part of the CellType identity key (D5) CellMarker-specific grouping; no matching concept in the UKC or the ontologies.

gloss_en: The broad health context in which CellMarker reports a cell type: Normal, Cancer, or Disease (other diseases).
gloss_source: written by the project (from the Phase 1 inspection of CellMarker)
notes: part of the CellType identity key (D5); values Normal / Cancer / Disease CellMarker-specific grouping; NCIt only has clinical (CTEP) disease categories.

gloss_en: part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function
gloss_source: UKC, concept 28479 (ukc.datascientia.eu)
notes: multi-valued The values (482 distinct) are tissue names, so the attribute is aligned to the concept 'tissue'.

gloss_en: The broader cell class under which CellMarker groups a cell name (248 values, e.g. Progenitor cell).
parent_concept: UKC-42808 (class: a collection of things sharing a common attribute)
gloss_source: written by the project (from the Phase 1 inspection of CellMarker)
notes: CellMarker-specific grouping; no matching concept in the UKC or the ontologies.

gloss_en: Cell type ontology concept ID.
parent_concept: EDAM:data_1087 (Ontology concept ID); EDAM:data_2893 (Cell type accession)
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_3238
notes: multi-valued; format CL_nnnnnnn UKC has only the generic 'identifier' (UKC-38423).

gloss_en: Identifier of an entry from a database of disease.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_3667
notes: identifying attribute UKC has only the generic 'identifier' (UKC-38423). Chosen over the more specific EDAM:data_1150 'Disease ID' (accession number).

gloss_en: A human-readable name for the subject.
gloss_source: W3C RDF Schema (http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#), rdfs:comment of rdfs:label
notes: merged with the Pathway label into the standard rdfs:label Standard RDF property, reused as it is (no tpkg: term).

gloss_en: The name of some disease.
gloss_source: EDAM 1.25 (2026-06-26), read through EBI OLS, EDAM:data_3668
notes: multi-valued; renamed: verbatim CellMarker disease names (D11) UKC has only the generic 'name' (UKC-2). The values are the disease names written as in CellMarker.
